parameters.query:
SELECT  DNS.DA, DNS.Article, DNS.DésignationArticle, DNS.QteDA, DAD.XMARQ_0 as marque,
        DNS.STU_0 AS Unite, DNS.Famille as Famille, DNS.SousFamille, DNS.CatégorieFamille,
        DNS.Observation, DNS.DateDA as date_da
FROM x3.BASE1.Y_DA_NON_SOLDEES DNS
LEFT JOIN x3.BASE1.PREQUIS DA ON DA.PSHNUM_0 = DNS.DA
INNER JOIN x3.BASE1.PREQUISD DAD ON DAD.PSHNUM_0 = DA.PSHNUM_0 AND DAD.ITMREF_0 = DNS.Article
WHERE DNS.Famille NOT LIKE 'SERVICE%'
  AND DNS.Famille NOT LIKE 'LOGISTIQUE%'
  AND DNS.Famille NOT LIKE 'R.H'
  AND DNS.Famille NOT LIKE 'ELECTRICITE'
  AND DNS.Article NOT IN ('A09985', 'A10107', 'A10136')
  AND CAST(DNS.DateDA AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
  AND DA.CLEFLG_0 = 1

INSERT INTO master.dbo.demande_achat_non_solde
    (da, article, designation_article, qte_da, marque, unite, famille,
     sous_famille, categorie_famille, observation, date_da)
SELECT
    '{{ $json.DA }}',
    '{{ $json.Article }}',
    '{{ ($json["DésignationArticle"] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json.QteDA ?? "NULL" }},
    '{{ ($json.marque || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.Unite }}',
    '{{ ($json.Famille || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.SousFamille || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json["CatégorieFamille"] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.Observation || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json.date_da ? "'" + new Date($json.date_da).toISOString().slice(0, 10) + "'" : "NULL" }}
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM master.dbo.demande_achat_non_solde
    WHERE da = '{{ $json.DA }}' AND article = '{{ $json.Article }}'
);
